# ZAYVORA Health OS™ — 45 Architectural Engines Specification

ZAYVORA Health OS™ operates 45 coordinated computational and clinical engines categorized across 6 domains:

### 1. Clinical & Classical Diagnostic Engines (1-10)
1. **Unani Intelligence Core:** Classical syndrome recognition (e.g. Waja-ul-Mafasil, Su-e-Hazm).
2. **Modern Biomedical Engine:** Inflammatory biomarker cross-talk and laboratory analyte correlation.
3. **ZAYVORA Base Knowledge Engine:** Authoritative repository of UPI monographs.
4. **ZKB Retrieval Engine:** Multi-hop graph and lexical retrieval.
5. **Mufradat Intelligence Engine:** Single herb monographs with temperament degrees.
6. **Murakkabat Formulation Engine:** Classical compound formulas and proportions.
7. **10-Ajnas Mizaj Engine:** Algorithmic calculation of dominant humor and dyscrasia.
8. **Organ-Axis Engine:** 12-axis multi-organ functional trajectory evaluator.
9. **Nuskha Nawisi Compiler:** 4-part formulation balancing (Juz-e-Azam, Muin, Musleh, Badal).
10. **Hakeem Sahab Copilot:** Advisory AI assistant enforcing mandatory clinician oversight.

### 2. Personalization, Safety & Therapeutics (11-20)
11. **ZAPE Personalization Engine:** Young/Cowling pediatric & geriatric eGFR posology scaling.
12. **Evidence Intelligence Engine:** Epistemological evidence classifier (E0 to E6).
13. **Deterministic Safety Firewall:** 6-dimensional contraindication and drug-herb interaction blocker.
14. **Differential Assessment Engine:** Unani Amraz to ICD-11 / SNOMED cross-mapping.
15. **Ilaj bil-Dawa Engine:** Posology and duration calibration.
16. **Ilaj bil-Ghiza Engine:** Mizaj-specific dietary regimens and food incompatibilities.
17. **Ilaj bil-Tadbeer Engine:** Regimenal safety thresholds (Hijama, Dalak, Hammam).
18. **Patient 360 Engine:** Comprehensive longitudinal clinical dossier assembler.
19. **Patient Timeline Engine:** Chronological care journey event mapper.
20. **Follow-up Engine:** Structured follow-up interval scheduler.

### 3. Pharmacy, Manufacturing & Governance (21-30)
21. **Outcome Intelligence Engine:** PROMs (VAS, WOMAC) quantitative improvement tracker.
22. **Pharmacovigilance Engine:** WHO-UMC causality and ICH E2B adverse event generator.
23. **Pharmacy Dispensing Engine:** Dispensary order orchestration.
24. **FEFO Inventory Allocator:** First-Expired First-Out batch allocator.
25. **Manufacturing eBMR Engine:** Master Formula Records & in-process QC limits.
26. **AI/RAG Semantic Engine:** Okapi BM25 and vector fusion.
27. **Knowledge Graph Engine:** Multi-hop entity relationship graph.
28. **Evidence Graph Engine:** Clinical trial to botanical linkage.
29. **Governance Quorum Engine:** 3/3 Clinical Governance Board change order voting.
30. **Consent & Privacy Engine:** HIPAA Safe Harbor / DISHA cryptographic pseudonymization.

### 4. Communication, Interoperability & Infrastructure (31-45)
31. **Notification Engine:** Multi-channel alert dispatcher.
32. **Billing & Payment Engine:** Cryptographic webhook and invoice reconciliation.
33. **Subscription Engine:** Care plan tier management.
34. **Reporting & Analytics Engine:** APM and clinical outcome telemetry.
35. **Search Engine:** Cmd+K global unified cross-domain search index.
36. **Audit Logging Engine:** SHA-256 Merkle tree immutable audit chain.
37. **RBAC Engine:** Multi-tenant role permissions catalogue.
38. **Interoperability / FHIR Engine:** HL7 FHIR R4 document bundle converter.
39. **ABDM Gateway:** National Health Authority ABHA verification & consent manager.
40. **QSURA Integration:** TRAI DLT compliant multi-channel messaging broker.
41. **Telemedicine Engine:** End-to-end encrypted WebRTC session manager.
42. **Document & PDF Engine:** SaMD regulatory inspection pack generator.
43. **Translation & Localization Engine:** Multilingual Bhashini vernacular voice synthesizer.
44. **Disaster Recovery Engine:** Point-in-time recovery (PITR) and snapshot verifier.
45. **Observability Engine:** W3C trace context propagation and Prometheus metrics.
